rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone bold or gutsy in a difficult situation.

example.english: They were really gutsy to go in there despite how dangerous it was.
example.traditional: 佢喺咁危險嘅情況下仲敢行入去，真係好大膽。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai2 gam3 ngai4 him2 ge3 cing4 fong3 haa6 zung6 gam2 haang4 jap6 heoi3 zan1 hai6 hou2 daai6 daam2

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is courage in danger or hardship rather than audacity.

example.english: The firefighter was truly gutsy to risk their life saving people.
example.traditional: 消防員冒住生命危險救人，真係好勇敢。
example.jyutping: siu1 fong4 jyun4 mou6 zyu6 sang1 ming6 ngai4 him2 gau3 jan4 zan1 hai6 hou2 jung5 gam2

rows.note: Use this colloquial expression for someone who has the guts to do something, especially before an action.

example.english: If you’re gutsy enough, go up on stage and speak yourself.
example.traditional: 你夠膽就自己上台講啦。
example.jyutping: nei5 gau3 daam2 zau6 zi6 gei2 soeng5 toi1 gong2 laa1
